description.zh: 定时提醒休息：小休看看远处，大休起来走走，可以设成必须休完
description.en: Reminds you to take breaks: look away for a short one, get up for a long one; can be made strict

notes.zh: “提前多少秒提醒”设成 0 时，到点直接休息，不再先闪一下提示条。权限不变。
notes.en: With the notice set to 0 seconds, a break starts when due without the notice bar flashing first. Permissions unchanged.
